name: Low Durability Switcher
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: FanyaOff
description: This mod saves you from unfortunate tool breakage by switching the slot to another

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Key R turns tool switching on or off ('Tool Switching: Yes/No' in the action bar, off by default); while on, a held tool with 10 or less durability left is swapped for a safe hotbar slot with 'Low durability tool has been replaced!'. Key G turns the low-armour sound alert on or off.
note: Not yet: Its settings screen (Mod Menu, cloth config) doesn't open; the toggle is saved to its config file, so a game folder where it was left on would say 'No' first.
